quote: The whole body crude protein and lipid contents of fish reared at 27°C were higher than in the 33°C group.

text_en: Fish reared at 27°C had higher whole-body crude protein and lipid contents than the 33°C group.

quote:
수온변화에 따른 성장 및 사료이용성의 조사는 어류양식을 성
공적으로 이끄는 매우 중요한 요인이다.
statement: 수온 변화에 따른 성장 및 사료 이용성 조사는 어류 양식 성공의 중요한 요인이다.
text_en: 수온 변화에 따른 성장 및 사료 이용성 조사는 어류 양식 성공의 중요한 요인이다.

연구가 수행 되었는데, 수온 26-29℃에서 최적의 성장과 사료

quote:
실험어는 충청북도내수면산업연구소에서 배합사료로 순치시
킨 쏘가리 치어(2.0 g)를 사용하였다.
statement: 실험어는 배합사료에 순치된 쏘가리 치어를 사용하였다.
text_en: 실험어는 배합사료에 순치된 쏘가리 치어를 사용하였다.

27℃, 29℃, 31℃ 및 33℃에 적응시켰다.
statement: 실험 시작 2주 전부터 쏘가리 치어를 실험 수온에 적응시켰다.
text_en: 실험 시작 2주 전부터 쏘가리 치어를 실험 수온에 적응시켰다.

quote:
각 수온별로 2반복으
로 원형 FRP 실험수조(200 L) 8개에 실험어를 수용하여 1일 2
회 만복으로 실험사료를 8주간 공급하였다.

수조(4개)인 원형 FRP 수조(3,000 L)에 자동온도조절기를 각
각 설치하여 기름보일러(500,000 kcal)를 이용하여 수온을 조
절하였다.

statement: 하천수 공급과 초과 배출을 통해 깨끗한 수질을 유지하였다.
text_en: 하천수 공급과 초과 배출을 통해 깨끗한 수질을 유지하였다.

을 설치하였다.
statement: 충분한 산소 공급을 위해 에어스톤을 설치하였다.
text_en: 충분한 산소 공급을 위해 에어스톤을 설치하였다.

quote: 粗蛋白含量达50%—65%, 必需氨基酸比例接近鱼粉, 且富含抗菌肽及几丁质等活性物质, 在促进鱼类生长、调节免疫方面表现出独特优势
statement: 蝇蛆粉粗蛋白含量高，氨基酸比例接近鱼粉，且因含抗菌肽和几丁质，在促进生长和调节免疫方面有优势。
text_zh: 蝇蛆粉粗蛋白含量高，氨基酸比例接近鱼粉，且因含抗菌肽和几丁质，在促进生长和调节免疫方面有优势。
text_en: Fly maggot meal has a high crude protein content, with an amino acid profile close to that of fish meal. Due to its content of antimicrobial peptides and chitin, it has advantages in promoting growth and regulating immunity.

quote: 翘嘴鳜作为典型肉食性物种, 对饲料蛋白需求高(≥45%), 且对蛋白源结构敏感, 不当替代易引发摄食抑制、代谢紊乱等问题
statement: 翘嘴鳜对蛋白源结构敏感，不当替代容易引发摄食抑制和代谢紊乱。
text_zh: 翘嘴鳜对蛋白源结构敏感，不当替代容易引发摄食抑制和代谢紊乱。
text_en: Siniperca chuatsi is sensitive to protein source structure; inappropriate substitution easily triggers feeding inhibition and metabolic disorders.

quote: 已有研究表明, 翘嘴鳜下丘脑摄食调控网络对蛋白源变化极为敏感, 其神经肽Y (npy)、刺鼠相关蛋白(agrp)等食欲信号分子的表达紊乱, 是导致摄食下降的关键生理机制
statement: 翘嘴鳜下丘脑摄食调控网络对蛋白源变化敏感，食欲信号分子表达紊乱是摄食下降的机制。
text_zh: 翘嘴鳜下丘脑摄食调控网络对蛋白源变化敏感，食欲信号分子表达紊乱是摄食下降的机制。
text_en: The hypothalamic feeding regulation network of the topmouth culter is sensitive to changes in protein source, and disordered expression of appetite signaling molecules is the mechanism for decreased feeding.

quote: 值得注意的是, 含硫氨基酸牛磺酸作为重要的神经递质和细胞保护剂, 对调节鱼类下丘脑食欲信号通路、维持正常摄食行为尤为关键
statement: 牛磺酸对调节鱼类下丘脑食欲信号通路和维持正常摄食行为至关重要。
text_zh: 牛磺酸对调节鱼类下丘脑食欲信号通路和维持正常摄食行为至关重要。
text_en: Taurine is essential for regulating the hypothalamic appetite signaling pathway and maintaining normal feeding behavior in fish.

quote: 蝇蛆粉饲料添加牛磺酸对翘嘴鳜摄食、生长及肌肉品质的影响
statement: 研究旨在探讨在蝇蛆粉饲料中添加牛磺酸对翘嘴鳜的摄食、生长及肌肉品质的影响。
text_zh: 研究旨在探讨在蝇蛆粉饲料中添加牛磺酸对翘嘴鳜的摄食、生长及肌肉品质的影响。
text_en: The study aimed to investigate the effects of adding taurine to black soldier fly larva meal-based feed on feeding, growth, and muscle quality of topmouth culter (Siniperca chuatsi).
intervention: Maggot meal replacing fishmeal with taurine
intervention_record: 蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉并添加牛磺酸

quote: HMM和HMM+Tau两处理组增重率均高于Con组, 饲料系数均低于Con组, 但无显著差异(P>0.05)。
statement: 蝇蛆粉组和蝇蛆粉+牛磺酸组的增重率高于对照组，饲料系数低于对照组，但差异不显著。
text_zh: 蝇蛆粉组和蝇蛆粉+牛磺酸组的增重率高于对照组，饲料系数低于对照组，但差异不显著。
text_en: The weight gain rate of the maggot meal group and the maggot meal + taurine group was higher than that of the control group, and the feed conversion ratio was lower than that of the control group, but the differences were not significant.
intervention: Maggot meal or maggot meal plus taurine
intervention_record: 添加蝇蛆粉或蝇蛆粉加牛磺酸

quote: HMM组的摄食率显著低于其他两组(P<0.05), Con和HMM+Tau组的摄食率没有显著性差异(P>0.05)
statement: 18%蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉导致翘嘴鳜摄食率显著降低，而补充牛磺酸后摄食率与对照组无显著差异。
text_zh: 18%蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉导致翘嘴鳜摄食率显著降低，而补充牛磺酸后摄食率与对照组无显著差异。
text_en: Replacing fishmeal with 18% maggot meal significantly reduced the feeding rate of topmouth culter, while supplementing taurine resulted in no significant difference in feeding rate compared to the control group.

quote: HMM+Tau组npy和ghrelin相对表达量显著上调(P<0.05)
statement: 在蝇蛆粉饲料中添加牛磺酸显著上调了npy和ghrelin的相对表达量。
text_zh: 在蝇蛆粉饲料中添加牛磺酸显著上调了npy和ghrelin的相对表达量。
text_en: The addition of taurine to maggot meal feed significantly upregulated the relative expression levels of npy and ghrelin.

quote: HMM和HMM+Tau组pomca相对表达量显著低于Con组(P<0.05)
statement: 使用蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉（无论是否添加牛磺酸）均导致pomca相对表达量显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 使用蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉（无论是否添加牛磺酸）均导致pomca相对表达量显著低于对照组。
text_en: Replacing fishmeal with black soldier fly larvae meal (with or without taurine supplementation) resulted in significantly lower relative expression of pomca compared to the control group.

quote: 各处理组生长和饲料系数没有显著差异
statement: 不同处理组之间在生长性能和饲料系数上没有显著差异。
text_zh: 不同处理组之间在生长性能和饲料系数上没有显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in growth performance and feed conversion ratio among the different treatment groups.
intervention: Maggot meal replacing fishmeal with taurine
intervention_record: 蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉并添加牛磺酸

quote: 综上所述, 蝇蛆粉作为优质蛋白源可有效替代鱼粉对翘嘴鳜生长和饲料利用没有影响, 同时补充牛磺酸可以促进翘嘴鳜摄食, 改善肌肉品质。
statement: 研究结论认为蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉不影响生长和饲料利用，且补充牛磺酸可促进摄食并改善肌肉品质。
text_zh: 研究结论认为蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉不影响生长和饲料利用，且补充牛磺酸可促进摄食并改善肌肉品质。
text_en: The study concluded that replacing fish meal with maggot meal did not affect growth and feed utilization, and supplementing taurine could promote feeding and improve muscle quality.

quote:
혈액분석
사육수온에 따른 실험어의 혈액성분 변화를 조사하기 위해
각 실험수조마다 쏘가리 5마리씩 무작위로 추출하여 헤파린
주사액이 처리된 1mL 주사기를 사용하여 실험어의 미부 혈
관에서 채혈하였다.
statement: 사육 수온에 따른 혈액 성분 변화 조사를 위해 각 수조에서 5마리를 무작위 추출하여 미부 혈관에서 채혈하였다.
text_en: 사육 수온에 따른 혈액 성분 변화 조사를 위해 각 수조에서 5마리를 무작위 추출하여 미부 혈관에서 채혈하였다.

quote:
채혈한 혈액을 7,500 rpm에서 10분간 원
심분리하여 얻은 혈장을 동결보존(-70℃)하면서 혈액분석기
(DRI-CHEM NX500i, FUJIFILM)를 사용하여 total protein
(TP), total cholesterol (TC), glutamic oxaloacetic transami­
nase (GOT), glutamic pyruvic transaminase (GPT), alkaline
phosphatase (ALP), bilirubin 및 albumin을 각각 분석하였다.
statement: 채혈한 혈액을 원심분리한 후 혈장을 -70℃에서 동결 보존하며 혈액분석기로 TP, TC, GOT, GPT, ALP, 빌리루빈, 알부민을 분석하였다.
text_en: 채혈한 혈액을 원심분리한 후 혈장을 -70℃에서 동결 보존하며 혈액분석기로 TP, TC, GOT, GPT, ALP, 빌리루빈, 알부민을 분석하였다.

quote:
사육실험기간 동안의 생존율은
98% 이상으로 나타났으며, 모든 실험구간에 통계적인 차이는
없었다(P>0.05).
statement: 사육 기간 중 생존율은 98% 이상이었으며, 실험 구간에는 통계적 차이가 없었다.
text_en: 사육 기간 중 생존율은 98% 이상이었으며, 실험 구간에는 통계적 차이가 없었다.

quote:
증중율, 일간성장율 및 사료효율은 수온 31℃
까지는 수온이 증가함에 따라 증가하다가 33℃에서는 감소하
는 경향을 보였다.
statement: 증중율, 일간성장율 및 사료효율은 수온 31℃까지 증가하다가 33℃에서 감소하는 경향을 보였다.
text_en: 증중율, 일간성장율 및 사료효율은 수온 31℃까지 증가하다가 33℃에서 감소하는 경향을 보였다.

quote:
증중율은 수온 31℃ 실험구가 수온 27℃,
29℃ 및 33℃ 실험구보다 유의하게 높았다(P<0.05).
statement: 증중율은 수온 31℃ 실험구가 27℃, 29℃ 및 33℃ 실험구보다 유의하게 높았다.
text_en: 증중율은 수온 31℃ 실험구가 27℃, 29℃ 및 33℃ 실험구보다 유의하게 높았다.

quote:
일간성장
율은 수온 31℃ 실험구가 수온 27℃ 및 33℃ 실험구보다 유의
하게 높았으나, 수온 29℃와는 유의차가 없었다(P>0.05).
statement: 일간성장율은 수온 31℃ 실험구가 27℃ 및 33℃ 실험구보다 유의하게 높았으나, 29℃와는 유의차가 없었다.
text_en: 일간성장율은 수온 31℃ 실험구가 27℃ 및 33℃ 실험구보다 유의하게 높았으나, 29℃와는 유의차가 없었다.

quote: 本研究发现, 在饲料中添加蝇蛆粉显著降低了翘嘴鳜的摄食率, 但补充牛磺酸后又恢复到对照组水平。
statement: 添加蝇蛆粉显著降低了翘嘴鳜的摄食率，而补充牛磺酸后摄食率恢复至对照组水平。
text_zh: 添加蝇蛆粉显著降低了翘嘴鳜的摄食率，而补充牛磺酸后摄食率恢复至对照组水平。
text_en: Adding maggot meal significantly reduced the feeding rate of Chinese perch, while supplementing taurine restored the feeding rate to the level of the control group.
intervention: Maggot meal replacing fishmeal with taurine
intervention_record: 蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉并添加牛磺酸

quote: 而牛磺酸的补充则具有缓解作用, 能够恢复正常的摄食水平。
statement: 牛磺酸的补充具有缓解作用，能够恢复正常的摄食水平。
text_zh: 牛磺酸的补充具有缓解作用，能够恢复正常的摄食水平。
text_en: Taurine supplementation has a mitigating effect and can restore normal feeding levels.

quote: 但该机制尚缺乏对味觉受体刺激的直接实验证据, 需进一步研究。
statement: 关于牛磺酸通过刺激味觉受体改善摄食的机制，目前尚缺乏直接的实验证据。
text_zh: 关于牛磺酸通过刺激味觉受体改善摄食的机制，目前尚缺乏直接的实验证据。
text_en: There is currently a lack of direct experimental evidence regarding the mechanism by which taurine improves feed intake through stimulation of taste receptors.
limitations: 缺乏对味觉受体刺激的直接实验证据

quote: 牛磺酸的联合添加进一步增强了摄食促进因子npy和ghre-lin的表达, 而摄食抑制因子pomca显著下调, 显示其可能通过调节下丘脑营养感知机制改善鱼类摄食动力
statement: 牛磺酸的联合添加增强了摄食促进因子npy和ghrelin的表达，并下调了摄食抑制因子pomcα，可能通过调节下丘脑营养感知机制改善摄食动力。
text_zh: 牛磺酸的联合添加增强了摄食促进因子npy和ghrelin的表达，并下调了摄食抑制因子pomcα，可能通过调节下丘脑营养感知机制改善摄食动力。
text_en: The combined addition of taurine enhanced the expression of the orexigenic factors npy and ghrelin, and downregulated the anorexigenic factor pomcα, possibly improving feeding motivation by regulating hypothalamic nutrient sensing mechanisms.
intervention: Maggot meal replacing fishmeal with taurine
intervention_record: 蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉并添加牛磺酸

quote: 已有研究指出, 牛磺酸不仅可作为神经递质调节剂, 参与谷氨酸和GABA等神经递质的平衡, 从而影响下丘脑摄食中枢的活性
statement: 已有研究指出牛磺酸可作为神经递质调节剂，影响下丘脑摄食中枢的活性。
text_zh: 已有研究指出牛磺酸可作为神经递质调节剂，影响下丘脑摄食中枢的活性。
text_en: Existing research indicates that taurine can act as a neurotransmitter modulator, affecting the activity of the hypothalamic feeding center.

quote: 还可通过刺激味觉受体提高饲料适口性

text_zh: 牛磺酸可通过刺激味觉受体提高饲料适口性。
text_en: Taurine can improve feed palatability by stimulating taste receptors.

quote: 牛磺酸能够调节下丘脑的饥饿信号通路, 并通过改善能量代谢途径促进摄食行为的稳定性
statement: 牛磺酸能调节下丘脑饥饿信号通路，并通过改善能量代谢促进摄食行为的稳定性。
text_zh: 牛磺酸能调节下丘脑饥饿信号通路，并通过改善能量代谢促进摄食行为的稳定性。
text_en: Taurine can regulate hypothalamic hunger signaling pathways and promote the stability of feeding behavior by improving energy metabolism.

quote: 因此, 牛磺酸促进摄食的作用机制可能是多方面的, 涉及神经信号、味觉调控及代谢稳态的协同作用。
statement: 牛磺酸促进摄食的作用机制可能是多方面的，涉及神经信号、味觉调控及代谢稳态的协同作用。
text_zh: 牛磺酸促进摄食的作用机制可能是多方面的，涉及神经信号、味觉调控及代谢稳态的协同作用。
text_en: The mechanism by which taurine promotes feeding may be multifaceted, involving the synergistic action of neural signaling, taste regulation, and metabolic homeostasis.

quote: 蝇蛆粉与牛磺酸的协同效应还可能进一步影响中枢能量感知和下游代谢调控, 增强饥饿驱动行为, 从而改善饲料适口性。
statement: 蝇蛆粉与牛磺酸的协同效应可能通过影响中枢能量感知和代谢调控来增强饥饿驱动行为，从而改善饲料适口性。
text_zh: 蝇蛆粉与牛磺酸的协同效应可能通过影响中枢能量感知和代谢调控来增强饥饿驱动行为，从而改善饲料适口性。
text_en: The synergistic effect of housefly maggot meal and taurine may enhance hunger-driven behavior by affecting central energy sensing and metabolic regulation, thereby improving feed palatability.
intervention: Maggot meal replacing fishmeal with taurine
intervention_record: 蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉并添加牛磺酸

quote: 蝇蛆粉+牛磺酸组虽也未显著提升增重率, 但同样高于对照组, 这可能在维持脂类代谢与缓解氧化压力方面可能起到调控作用, 从而帮助鱼类在高能饲料中保持稳定生长速率
statement: 蝇蛆粉添加牛磺酸虽未显著提升增重率，但高于对照组，可能通过维持脂类代谢和缓解氧化压力帮助鱼类保持稳定的生长速率。
text_zh: 蝇蛆粉添加牛磺酸虽未显著提升增重率，但高于对照组，可能通过维持脂类代谢和缓解氧化压力帮助鱼类保持稳定的生长速率。
text_en: Although the addition of taurine to maggot meal did not significantly improve the weight gain rate, it was higher than that of the control group, possibly helping fish maintain a stable growth rate by sustaining lipid metabolism and alleviating oxidative stress.
intervention: Maggot meal replacing fishmeal with taurine
intervention_record: 蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉并添加牛磺酸

quote: 此外, 蝇蛆粉富含几丁质和抗菌肽等生物活性成分, 可改善肠道菌群结构与营养利用效率, 从而间接提升肌肉营养水平
statement: 蝇蛆粉中的几丁质和抗菌肽可改善肠道菌群结构和营养利用效率，进而间接提升肌肉营养水平。
text_zh: 蝇蛆粉中的几丁质和抗菌肽可改善肠道菌群结构和营养利用效率，进而间接提升肌肉营养水平。
text_en: Chitin and antimicrobial peptides in maggot meal can improve gut microbiota structure and nutrient utilization efficiency, thereby indirectly enhancing muscle nutritional levels.

quote: 已有研究表明, 牛磺酸补充可以通过调节代谢通路, 促进脂肪酸合成与转运, 从而维持脂肪酸组成的稳定, 缓解高脂饲料所致的代谢紊乱
statement: 牛磺酸补充可通过调节代谢通路促进脂肪酸合成与转运，维持脂肪酸组成稳定并缓解高脂饲料引起的代谢紊乱。
text_zh: 牛磺酸补充可通过调节代谢通路促进脂肪酸合成与转运，维持脂肪酸组成稳定并缓解高脂饲料引起的代谢紊乱。
text_en: Taurine supplementation can promote fatty acid synthesis and transport by regulating metabolic pathways, maintain stable fatty acid composition, and alleviate metabolic disorders caused by high-fat diets.

quote: This study investigated the effect of addition of fish meal and smelt on the growth, blood content and body composition of mandarin fish, Siniperca scherzeri.
statement: 이 연구는 어분과 빙어 첨가가 쏘가리의 성장, 혈액성상 및 체조성에 미치는 영향을 조사하였다.
text_en: 이 연구는 어분과 빙어 첨가가 쏘가리의 성장, 혈액성상 및 체조성에 미치는 영향을 조사하였다.

quote: Two replicates groups of fish (average weight of 114 g) were fed one of the six experimental diets twice daily for 10 weeks.
statement: 평균 체중 114g의 어류 두 복귀 그룹에게 6가지 실험 사료 중 하나를 하루에 두 번씩 10주간 급여하였다.
text_en: 평균 체중 114g의 어류 두 복귀 그룹에게 6가지 실험 사료 중 하나를 하루에 두 번씩 10주간 급여하였다.

quote: These results indicate that mandarin fish require high protein level in diet for growth and feed efficiency.
statement: 이러한 결과는 쏘가리가 성장과 사료 효율을 위해 높은 단백질 수준의 사료를 필요로 함을 나타낸다.
text_en: 이러한 결과는 쏘가리가 성장과 사료 효율을 위해 높은 단백질 수준의 사료를 필요로 함을 나타낸다.

quote: 쏘가리 양식현장에서는 생먹이, 냉동먹이, 담수어 시판사료 및 시판사료에 다양한 원료를 첨가하여 자체 제작한 사료를 공급하면서 사육관리하고 있는 실정으로, 먹이종류에 따른 효능의 과학적인 비교, 분석없이 사용하고 있다.
statement: 쏘가리 양식 현장에서는 여러 종류의 먹이를 사용하지만, 그 효능에 대한 과학적 비교나 분석 없이 적용되고 있다.
text_en: 쏘가리 양식 현장에서는 여러 종류의 먹이를 사용하지만, 그 효능에 대한 과학적 비교나 분석 없이 적용되고 있다.

quote: 특히, 실제 쏘가리 양어가들은 시판사료와 이의 효율 향상을 위한 어분과 빙어 첨가에 대한 정확한 검증없이 적용하고 있다.
statement: 양어가들이 어분과 빙어를 첨가하는 것이 효율을 높인다고 믿지만, 이에 대한 정확한 검증은 이루어지지 않았다.
text_en: 양어가들이 어분과 빙어를 첨가하는 것이 효율을 높인다고 믿지만, 이에 대한 정확한 검증은 이루어지지 않았다.

quote: 어류의 사료 섭취는 사육환경, 사료조성, 사료형태 및 사료공급체계 등에 영향을 받는다(Lee et al., 2000a; Lee et al., 2000b).
statement: 어류의 사료 섭취량은 사육 환경, 사료 조성, 형태 및 공급 체계 등 여러 요인의 영향을 받는다.
text_en: 어류의 사료 섭취량은 사육 환경, 사료 조성, 형태 및 공급 체계 등 여러 요인의 영향을 받는다.

quote: 이 중 사료조성 및 사료형태는 어류의 성장 및 사료효율을 개선시킬 수 있다(Lee et al., 2000b; Ng et al., 2000).
statement: 사료의 조성과 형태를 조절하면 어류의 성장과 사료 효율을 개선할 수 있다.
text_en: 사료의 조성과 형태를 조절하면 어류의 성장과 사료 효율을 개선할 수 있다.

quote: 실험어는 충청북도내수면산업연구소에서 배합사료로 순치하여 양성한 쏘가리를 사용하였으며,
statement: 실험에 사용된 쏘가리는 배합사료에 순치(적응)되어 양성되었다.
text_en: 실험에 사용된 쏘가리는 배합사료에 순치(적응)되어 양성되었다.

text_en: 혈액성분 분석을 위해 실험 종료 시 미부 혈관에서 헤파린 처리 주사기로 채혈하였다.

text_en: FM45, FM60 및 PS 실험구의 일일단백질섭취율이 대조구(CD)와 FM15보다 유의하게 높았으나, FM30과는 차이가 없었다.

text_en: FM45, FM60 및 PS 실험구의 단백질전환효율이 대조구(CD)보다 유의하게 높았으나, FM15 및 FM30 간에는 유의적인 차이가 없었다.

statement: 사료 내 단백질 함량이 증가하면 어류 성장이 증가하다가, 요구량을 초과하면 성장이 유지되거나 감소하는 경향이 있다.
text_en: 사료 내 단백질 함량이 증가하면 어류 성장이 증가하다가, 요구량을 초과하면 성장이 유지되거나 감소하는 경향이 있다.

quote: Therefore, the best diets for mandarin fish were add to fish meal 45% or pond smelt 50% in commercial diets.
statement: 따라서 쏘가리를 위한 최적의 사료는 시판 사료에 어분 45% 또는 빙어 50%를 첨가한 것이었다.
text_en: 따라서 쏘가리를 위한 최적의 사료는 시판 사료에 어분 45% 또는 빙어 50%를 첨가한 것이었다.

quote: 그러나, 쏘가리는 육식성이 매우 강한 어종이며 살아있는 먹이만을 먹는 습성으로 실용사료가 개발되지 못한 실정이다. 살아있는 먹이를 공급해 쏘가리를 생산하는 것은 비경제적이고 효율적이지 않다.
statement: 쏘가리는 육식성이 강하여 살아있는 먹이만 섭취하는 습성으로 인해 실용 배합사료 개발이 어려웠으며, 살아있는 먹이 공급 방식은 비경제적이고 비효율적이다.
text_en: 쏘가리는 육식성이 강하여 살아있는 먹이만 섭취하는 습성으로 인해 실용 배합사료 개발이 어려웠으며, 살아있는 먹이 공급 방식은 비경제적이고 비효율적이다.

quote: 최근에 충청북도내수면연구소에서 쏘가리를 대량으로 배합사료에 순치시킬 수 있는 기술을 개발하였다(Kim and Lee, 2017).
statement: 충청북도내수면연구소에서 쏘가리를 대량으로 배합사료에 순치(적응)시키는 기술을 개발하였다.
text_en: 충청북도내수면연구소에서 쏘가리를 대량으로 배합사료에 순치(적응)시키는 기술을 개발하였다.

quote: 이러한 결과를 바탕으로 쏘가리 전용사료 개발을 위한 단백질과 지질함량에 대한 연구(Zohreh et al., 2017)와 더불어 쏘가리의 적정 사육수온(Kim and Lee, 2016), 사료내의 어분첨가 효과(Kim and Lee, 2017) 및 사육밀도(Lee and Kim, 2017) 연구가 수행되었다.
statement: 쏘가리 전용사료 개발을 위해 단백질/지질 함량, 적정 사육수온, 어분 첨가 효과 및 사육밀도에 관한 연구들이 수행되었다.
text_en: 쏘가리 전용사료 개발을 위해 단백질/지질 함량, 적정 사육수온, 어분 첨가 효과 및 사육밀도에 관한 연구들이 수행되었다.

quote: 另一方面, 饲料系数未显著下降, 蝇蛆粉组和蝇蛆粉+牛磺酸组的饲料利用效率仍高于对照组
statement: 虽然饲料系数没有显著降低，但添加蝇蛆粉或蝇蛆粉加牛磺酸的组别饲料利用效率高于对照组。
text_zh: 虽然饲料系数没有显著降低，但添加蝇蛆粉或蝇蛆粉加牛磺酸的组别饲料利用效率高于对照组。
text_en: Although the feed conversion ratio was not significantly reduced, the groups supplemented with maggot meal or maggot meal plus taurine had higher feed utilization efficiency than the control group.
intervention: Maggot meal or maggot meal plus taurine
intervention_record: 添加蝇蛆粉或蝇蛆粉加牛磺酸

quote: 这可能与蝇蛆粉中富含的几丁质和小肽对肠道菌群代谢和肠道结构的优化作用有关
statement: 饲料利用效率的提高可能与蝇蛆粉中的几丁质和小肽优化肠道菌群代谢及结构有关。
text_zh: 饲料利用效率的提高可能与蝇蛆粉中的几丁质和小肽优化肠道菌群代谢及结构有关。
text_en: The improvement in feed utilization efficiency may be related to the optimization of gut microbiota metabolism and structure by chitin and small peptides in black soldier fly meal.

quote: 本研究表明, 蝇蛆粉可有效替代鱼粉, 在翘嘴鳜的摄食、生长和肌肉品质上无显著负面影响, 且能够增加肌肉中的氨基酸含量。
statement: 蝇蛆粉有效替代鱼粉后，翘嘴鳜的摄食、生长和肌肉品质无显著负面影响，且肌肉氨基酸含量增加。
text_zh: 蝇蛆粉有效替代鱼粉后，翘嘴鳜的摄食、生长和肌肉品质无显著负面影响，且肌肉氨基酸含量增加。
text_en: After housefly maggot meal effectively replaced fish meal, there was no significant negative impact on the feeding, growth, and muscle quality of Chinese perch (Siniperca chuatsi), and the muscle amino acid content increased.

quote: 研究还发现, 牛磺酸的添加可通过改善味觉适口性和调节摄食信号通路, 进一步促进鱼类的摄食行为。
statement: 添加牛磺酸通过改善味觉适口性和调节摄食信号通路，促进了鱼类的摄食行为。
text_zh: 添加牛磺酸通过改善味觉适口性和调节摄食信号通路，促进了鱼类的摄食行为。
text_en: Taurine supplementation promoted feeding behavior in fish by improving taste palatability and regulating feeding signaling pathways.

quote: 蝇蛆粉与牛磺酸的联合使用能够优化饲料组成, 提高饲料适口性, 为饲料行业提供了一种潜力巨大的替代蛋白方案。
statement: 蝇蛆粉与牛磺酸联合使用能优化饲料组成并提高适口性，是一种有潜力的替代蛋白方案。
text_zh: 蝇蛆粉与牛磺酸联合使用能优化饲料组成并提高适口性，是一种有潜力的替代蛋白方案。
text_en: The combined use of maggot meal and taurine can optimize feed composition and improve palatability, representing a potential alternative protein solution.
intervention: Maggot meal replacing fishmeal with taurine
intervention_record: 蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉并添加牛磺酸

quote: Altogether, our results support the hypothesis that social learning could facilitate the acquisition of novel feeding habits in fish, and it considerably increases the rate of subsequent individual food intake and domestication through the interaction between the learning gene c-fos and the appetite control gene pomc .
statement: 研究结果表明，社会学习可能促进鱼类获取新的摄食习惯，并通过学习基因c-fos与食欲控制基因pomc之间的相互作用，显著提高随后的个体食物摄入量和驯化率。
text_zh: 研究结果表明，社会学习可能促进鱼类获取新的摄食习惯，并通过学习基因c-fos与食欲控制基因pomc之间的相互作用，显著提高随后的个体食物摄入量和驯化率。
text_en: The results indicate that social learning may promote fish acquiring new feeding habits, and significantly increase subsequent individual food intake and domestication rate through the interaction between the learning gene c-fos and the appetite control gene pomc.

quote: Groups of fish forage more efficiently than individuals, such as the goldfish ( Carassius auratus auratus ), bluntnose minnows ( Pimephales notatus ), Alaska pollock ( Theragra chalcogramma ) and sticklebacks ( Gasterosteus aculeatus ) [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ].
statement: 群体觅食比个体觅食效率更高，这在金鱼、钝鼻鲦鱼、阿拉斯加鳕鱼和刺鱼中已有报道。
text_zh: 群体觅食比个体觅食效率更高，这在金鱼、钝鼻鲦鱼、阿拉斯加鳕鱼和刺鱼中已有报道。
text_en: Group foraging is more efficient than individual foraging, as reported in goldfish, bluntnose minnows, Alaska pollock, and sticklebacks.

population.species: 金鱼, 钝鼻鲦鱼, 阿拉斯加鳕鱼, 刺鱼

quote: 어분및빙어첨가가쏘가리(Siniperca scherzeri)의성장, 혈액성상및체조성에미치는영향
statement: 본 연구는 어분 및 빙어 첨가가 쏘가리의 성장, 혈액성상 및 체조성에 미치는 영향을 조사한다.
text_en: 본 연구는 어분 및 빙어 첨가가 쏘가리의 성장, 혈액성상 및 체조성에 미치는 영향을 조사한다.

quote: 사육실험 기간 동안의 생존율은 93.5% 이상으로 나타났으며, 모든 실험구간에 차이는 없었다(P>0.05).
statement: 10주간의 사육실험 기간 동안 모든 실험구의 생존율은 93.5% 이상이었으며, 실험구 간에 유의한 차이가 없었다.
text_en: 10주간의 사육실험 기간 동안 모든 실험구의 생존율은 93.5% 이상이었으며, 실험구 간에 유의한 차이가 없었다.

quote: 쏘가리의 일일사료섭취율(daily feed intake)은 FM45, FM60 및 PS실험구가 CD 및 FM15 보다 유의하게 낮은 결과를 나타내었으나(P<0.05), FM30와는 유의적인 차이는 없었다(P>0.05).
statement: FM45, FM60 및 PS(빙어) 실험구의 일일사료섭취율은 CD 및 FM15보다 유의하게 낮았으나, FM30과는 유의한 차이가 없었다.
text_en: FM45, FM60 및 PS(빙어) 실험구의 일일사료섭취율은 CD 및 FM15보다 유의하게 낮았으나, FM30과는 유의한 차이가 없었다.

quote: We found that the orexigenic gene agrp and the anorexigenic genes pomc and leptin a were significantly decreased in the fish of learning group ( p 0.05), while no changes were found in the expression of the npy , ghrelin , cart and cck genes between the two groups
statement: 在具有社会学习的鳜鱼组中，促食欲基因agrp和抑食欲基因pomc及leptin a的表达显著降低，而npy、ghrelin、cart和cck基因的表达在两组成对照组之间无变化。
text_zh: 在具有社会学习的鳜鱼组中，促食欲基因agrp和抑食欲基因pomc及leptin a的表达显著降低，而npy、ghrelin、cart和cck基因的表达在两组成对照组之间无变化。
text_en: In the mandarin fish group with social learning, the expression of the appetite-promoting gene agrp and the appetite-suppressing genes pomc and leptin a was significantly reduced, while the expression of npy, ghrelin, cart, and cck genes showed no change between the two control groups.
outcome: 摄食调节相关基因表达

quote: We designed a specific training paradigm to domesticate the feeding habits of mandarin fish, and we found that some individuals could accept dead prey fish successfully (feeders) [ 15 ].
statement: 研究人员设计了一种特定的训练范式来驯化鳜鱼的摄食习惯，发现部分个体能够成功接受死饵鱼。
text_zh: 研究人员设计了一种特定的训练范式来驯化鳜鱼的摄食习惯，发现部分个体能够成功接受死饵鱼。
text_en: Researchers designed a specific training paradigm to acclimate the feeding habits of mandarin fish, finding that some individuals were able to successfully accept dead bait fish.

quote: To investigate the effect of social learning on acquiring new feeding habits of mandarin fish, we examined the success rate of feeding habit domestication from live prey fish to dead prey fish, as well as the food intake of dead prey fish in mandarin fish with or without feeders of dead prey fish as demonstrator.
statement: 为了研究社会学习对鳜鱼获取新摄食习惯的影响，研究者检查了在有或无死饵鱼示范者的情况下，从活饵鱼到死饵鱼的摄食习惯驯化成功率以及死饵鱼的摄入量。
text_zh: 为了研究社会学习对鳜鱼获取新摄食习惯的影响，研究者检查了在有或无死饵鱼示范者的情况下，从活饵鱼到死饵鱼的摄食习惯驯化成功率以及死饵鱼的摄入量。
text_en: To study the effect of social learning on the acquisition of new feeding habits in mandarin fish, researchers examined the success rate of habituation from live baitfish to dead baitfish and the intake of dead baitfish in the presence or absence of a dead-baitfish demonstrator.

quote: The success rate of feeding habit domestication from live prey fish to dead prey fish in the learning group (with the positive demonstration fish) was significantly higher than in that of the control group (with the negative demonstration fish), and the learning times were significantly decreased in the learning group
statement: 在驯化从活饵鱼到死饵鱼的摄食习惯时，使用阳性示范鱼的学习组比使用阴性示范鱼的对照组成功率显著更高，且学习时间显著减少。
text_zh: 在驯化从活饵鱼到死饵鱼的摄食习惯时，使用阳性示范鱼的学习组比使用阴性示范鱼的对照组成功率显著更高，且学习时间显著减少。
text_en: When training the feeding habit from live bait fish to dead bait fish, the learning group using positive demonstrator fish had a significantly higher success rate and significantly reduced learning time compared to the control group using negative demonstrator fish.

quote: The enhancement of foraging by social learning has also been reported in hatchery-reared juvenile chum salmon ( Oncorhynchus keta ), Alaska pollock and rock bass ( Ambloplites rupestris ) [ 8 , 10 , 11 ].
statement: 社会学习对觅食的增强作用也在孵化场饲养的大马哈鱼幼鱼、阿拉斯加鳕鱼和岩鲈中被报道过。
text_zh: 社会学习对觅食的增强作用也在孵化场饲养的大马哈鱼幼鱼、阿拉斯加鳕鱼和岩鲈中被报道过。
text_en: The enhancement of foraging by social learning has also been reported in hatchery-reared Chinook salmon juveniles, Alaska pollock, and rock bass.

population.species: 大马哈鱼, 阿拉斯加鳕鱼, 岩鲈

quote: 사료내 단백질 함량이 높아짐에 따라 유의하게 높은 사료효율, 일일사료섭취율 및 단백질 전환효율을 보인 점으로 보아, 사료내 낮은 단백질 함량의 사료보다 높은 단백질 함량의 사료를 효율적으로 사용한다는 것을 의미한다.
statement: 사료 단백질 함량이 높을수록 사료 효율, 일일 섭취율, 단백질 전환 효율이 높아져 고품질 사료를 더 효율적으로 이용함을 의미한다.
text_en: 사료 단백질 함량이 높을수록 사료 효율, 일일 섭취율, 단백질 전환 효율이 높아져 고품질 사료를 더 효율적으로 이용함을 의미한다.

quote: 다양한 먹이원에 따른 쏘가리의 수분, 단백질, 지질 및 회분 함량은 모든 실험구간에서 유의차가 없어 P>0.05)
statement: 다양한 먹이원 처리에 따라 쏘가리의 체조성(수분, 단백질, 지질, 회분)에는 유의한 차이가 없었다.
text_en: 다양한 먹이원 처리에 따라 쏘가리의 체조성(수분, 단백질, 지질, 회분)에는 유의한 차이가 없었다.

quote: 두 실험 모두에서 TP, TC, GOT, GPT, ALP, LDH 및 ALB 함량은 실험구간 유의차가 나타나지 않았다(P>0.05).
statement: 실험 구간에 따라 혈장 생화학적 지표(TP, TC, GOT, GPT, ALP, LDH, ALB)에 유의한 차이가 나타나지 않았다.
text_en: 실험 구간에 따라 혈장 생화학적 지표(TP, TC, GOT, GPT, ALP, LDH, ALB)에 유의한 차이가 나타나지 않았다.

quote: 본 연구의 결과로부터, 쏘가리는 시판 배합사료에 어분을 45% 첨가하거나, 빙어를 50% 첨가하여 사료 내 단백질 함량을 56%로 높여 주는 것이 쏘가리의 성장 및 사료효율을 증가시킬 수 있을 것으로 판단된다.
statement: 시판 배합사료에 어분 45% 또는 빙어 50%를 첨가하여 단백질 함량을 56%로 높이는 것이 성장과 사료효율을 증가시킬 수 있다고 판단된다.
text_en: 시판 배합사료에 어분 45% 또는 빙어 50%를 첨가하여 단백질 함량을 56%로 높이는 것이 성장과 사료효율을 증가시킬 수 있다고 판단된다.

quote: In the present study, we examined the success rate of feeding habit domestication from live prey fish to dead prey fish, as well as the food intake of dead prey fish in mandarin fish with or without feeders of dead prey fish as demonstrators.
statement: 本研究考察了鳜鱼从活饵驯化为死饵的成功率，以及在有或无死饵示范者存在时的死饵摄食量。
text_zh: 本研究考察了鳜鱼从活饵驯化为死饵的成功率，以及在有或无死饵示范者存在时的死饵摄食量。
text_en: This study examined the success rate of training mandarin fish from live bait to dead bait, and the amount of dead bait consumed in the presence or absence of a dead-bait demonstrator.

quote: Here, we found that mandarin fish can learn from each other how to solve novel foraging tasks, feeding on dead prey fish.
statement: 研究发现鳜鱼可以通过相互学习来解决新的觅食任务，即摄食死饵。
text_zh: 研究发现鳜鱼可以通过相互学习来解决新的觅食任务，即摄食死饵。
text_en: The study found that mandarin fish can solve new foraging tasks, namely feeding on dead bait, through social learning.

quote: the expression of the c-fos, fra2, zif268, c/ebpd and sytIV genes were significantly increased, and the anorexigenic pomc and leptin a expressions were decreased in fish of the learning group.
statement: 学习组中c-fos、fra2、zif268、c/ebpd和sytIV基因表达显著增加，而厌食性pomc和leptin a表达降低。
text_zh: 学习组中c-fos、fra2、zif268、c/ebpd和sytIV基因表达显著增加，而厌食性pomc和leptin a表达降低。
text_en: In the learning group, expression of c-fos, fra2, zif268, c/ebpd and sytIV genes increased significantly, while anorexigenic pomc and leptin a expression decreased.

quote: With the inhibitors of PKA and CaMKII signaling and the chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) assay, we further found that the social learning of new feeding habits in mandarin fish could be attributed to the activation of the CaMKII signaling pathway and then the stimulation of the expression of the c-fos gene, which might be an important transcriptional factor to inhibit the expression of the anorexigenic gene pomc , resulting in the food intake of dead prey fish in mandarin fish.
statement: 通过抑制剂和ChIP实验发现，鳜鱼新摄食习惯的社会学习可归因于CaMKII信号通路的激活及随后c-fos基因表达的刺激，这可能抑制厌食基因pomc的表达，从而导致鳜鱼摄食死饵。
text_zh: 通过抑制剂和ChIP实验发现，鳜鱼新摄食习惯的社会学习可归因于CaMKII信号通路的激活及随后c-fos基因表达的刺激，这可能抑制厌食基因pomc的表达，从而导致鳜鱼摄食死饵。
text_en: Through inhibitor and ChIP experiments, it was found that the social learning of a new feeding habit in mandarin fish can be attributed to the activation of the CaMKII signaling pathway and the subsequent stimulation of c-fos gene expression, which may inhibit the expression of the anorexia gene pomc, thereby leading mandarin fish to feed on dead bait.

quote: To confirm whether the PKA and CaMKII signaling pathways are involved in feeding habit domestication through social learning, we used the specific inhibitors to study the effects of PKA and CaMKII signaling on the regulation of the expression of learning and appetite control genes.
statement: 使用特异性抑制剂研究PKA和CaMKII信号通路在通过社会学习进行摄食习惯驯化中的作用，以及它们对学习基因和食欲控制基因表达的调节。
text_zh: 使用特异性抑制剂研究PKA和CaMKII信号通路在通过社会学习进行摄食习惯驯化中的作用，以及它们对学习基因和食欲控制基因表达的调节。
text_en: Use of specific inhibitors to study the role of PKA and CaMKII signaling pathways in feeding habit domestication through social learning, and their regulation of learning gene and appetite control gene expression.

quote: The food intake of dead prey fish was also increased in the learning group, and the learning times were decreased.
statement: 学习组中死饵鱼的摄入量增加，且学习时间减少。
text_zh: 学习组中死饵鱼的摄入量增加，且学习时间减少。
text_en: In the learning group, consumption of dead bait fish increased, and learning time decreased.

quote: Mandarin fish with the positive demonstration fish might be easier to be domesticated to accept dead prey fish, suggesting the social learning of acquiring new feeding habits in mandarin fish.
statement: 有阳性示范鱼的鳜鱼可能更容易被驯化以接受死饵鱼，这表明鳜鱼通过社会学习获取新的摄食习惯。
text_zh: 有阳性示范鱼的鳜鱼可能更容易被驯化以接受死饵鱼，这表明鳜鱼通过社会学习获取新的摄食习惯。
text_en: Chinese perch with positive demonstrator fish may be easier to train to accept dead bait fish, indicating that Chinese perch acquire new feeding habits through social learning.

quote: In the present study, compared with fish in the control group, the mRNA levels of c-fos , zif268 and c/ebpd were dramatically increased in fish of the learning group, suggesting that the social learning to exploit new food sources in mandarin fish might be attributed to the higher expression of the c-fos , zif268 and c/ebpd genes, potentially resulting in the long-term protentiation of a new feeding habit (feed on dead prey fish).
statement: 本研究发现，与对照组相比，学习组鳜鱼的c-fos、zif268和c/ebpd mRNA水平显著升高，表明利用新食物源的社会学习可能归因于这些基因的高表达，并可能导致摄食死饵鱼这一新摄食习惯的长期增强。
text_zh: 本研究发现，与对照组相比，学习组鳜鱼的c-fos、zif268和c/ebpd mRNA水平显著升高，表明利用新食物源的社会学习可能归因于这些基因的高表达，并可能导致摄食死饵鱼这一新摄食习惯的长期增强。
text_en: This study found that, compared with the control group, the mRNA levels of c-fos, zif268 and c/ebpd in mandarin fish were significantly elevated, indicating that social learning using a new food source may be attributed to the high expression of these genes and may lead to long-term enhancement of the new feeding habit of eating dead baitfish.
outcome: 摄食行为与神经可塑性

quote: Consistent with the increase of food intake of dead prey fish, mandarin fish with the positive demonstration fish showed a decrease of anorexigenic pomc and leptin a .
statement: 与对死饵鱼摄食量的增加一致，有积极示范鱼的鳜鱼表现出厌食性基因pomc和leptin a的表达下降。
text_zh: 与对死饵鱼摄食量的增加一致，有积极示范鱼的鳜鱼表现出厌食性基因pomc和leptin a的表达下降。
text_en: Consistent with an increase in the consumption of dead bait fish, mandarin fish with positive demonstrator fish showed decreased expression of the anorexia-related genes pomc and leptin a.

quote: Our study showed that mandarin fish were capable of social learning to acquire a new feeding habit.
statement: 本研究表明鳜鱼能够通过社会学习获得新的摄食习惯。
text_zh: 本研究表明鳜鱼能够通过社会学习获得新的摄食习惯。
text_en: This study shows that mandarin fish can acquire new feeding habits through social learning.

quote: The success rates of feeding habit domestication from live prey fish to dead prey fish was significantly higher in mandarin fish with the positive demonstration fish than that with the negative demonstration fish.
statement: 与阴性示范鱼相比，具有阳性示范鱼的鳜鱼从活饵鱼到死饵鱼的摄食习惯驯化成功率显著更高。
text_zh: 与阴性示范鱼相比，具有阳性示范鱼的鳜鱼从活饵鱼到死饵鱼的摄食习惯驯化成功率显著更高。
text_en: Compared to negative demonstrator fish, mandarin fish with positive demonstrator fish had a significantly higher success rate in habituating feeding habits from live bait fish to dead bait fish.

quote: Mandarin fish with the positive demonstration fish might be easier to be domesticated to feed on dead prey fish, suggesting that the learning ability of mandarin fish during the domestication of feeding habits.
statement: 具有阳性示范鱼的鳜鱼可能更容易被驯化为摄食死饵鱼，这表明了鳜鱼在摄食习惯驯化过程中的学习能力。
text_zh: 具有阳性示范鱼的鳜鱼可能更容易被驯化为摄食死饵鱼，这表明了鳜鱼在摄食习惯驯化过程中的学习能力。
text_en: Chinese perch with positive demonstrator fish may be easier to train to eat dead bait fish, which indicates the learning ability of Chinese perch in the process of training feeding habits.

quote: This is the first time that it has been shown that that social learning could enable mandarin fish with a naive feeding habit of live prey fish to acquire information of accepting dead prey fish from a knowledgeable one, thus avoiding the costs of learning solely by individual experience.
statement: 首次证明社会学习能使具有活饵鱼天真摄食习惯的鳜鱼从有经验的个体那里获取接受死饵鱼的信息，从而避免仅通过个人经验学习的成本。
text_zh: 首次证明社会学习能使具有活饵鱼天真摄食习惯的鳜鱼从有经验的个体那里获取接受死饵鱼的信息，从而避免仅通过个人经验学习的成本。
text_en: First demonstration that social learning enables mandarin fish with naive live-bait feeding habits to acquire information on accepting dead bait from experienced individuals, thereby avoiding the costs of learning solely through individual experience.

quote: The observation of a trained conspecific Atlantic salmon Salmo salar significantly increased the rate at which naive hatchery-reared fish accepted novel, live prey items [ 23 ].
statement: 观察经过训练的同类大西洋鲑显著提高了幼稚孵化场养殖鱼类接受新型活饵项目的速率。
text_zh: 观察经过训练的同类大西洋鲑显著提高了幼稚孵化场养殖鱼类接受新型活饵项目的速率。
text_en: Observing trained conspecific Atlantic salmon significantly increased the rate at which naive hatchery-reared fish accepted a novel live prey item.

quote: The young-of-the-year perch Perca fluviatilis could finish a shift from natural food items to commercial dry feeds faster through the presence of conspecifics that are familiar with the dry feed than without the demonstrators [ 24 ].
statement: 通过存在熟悉干饲料的同类，当年生河鲈比没有示范者时能更快地完成从天然食物到商业干饲料的转变。
text_zh: 通过存在熟悉干饲料的同类，当年生河鲈比没有示范者时能更快地完成从天然食物到商业干饲料的转变。
text_en: By having familiar dry feed conspecifics present, age-0 perch completed the transition from natural food to commercial dry feed faster than when there were no demonstrators.

quote: Previous studies have shown that changes due to experience increased the capture rate of a specific prey type and shortened the time to approach a novel food item in naive rainbow trout ( Oncorhynchus mykiss ) [ 25 ] and pink salmon ( Oncorhynchus gorbuscha ) [ 26 ].
statement: 先前的研究表明，由经验引起的变化增加了虹鳟和粉红鲑对特定猎物的捕获率，并缩短了接近新型食物的时间。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，由经验引起的变化增加了虹鳟和粉红鲑对特定猎物的捕获率，并缩短了接近新型食物的时间。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that experience-induced changes increased the capture rate of specific prey in rainbow trout and pink salmon, and shortened the time to approach novel food.

population.species: rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss), pink salmon (Oncorhynchus gorbuscha)

quote: Our results indicated that social learning could facilitate the acquisition of a novel feeding habit in mandarin fish and have a great effect on domestication and food intake.
statement: 我们的结果表明，社会学习可以促进鳜鱼获得新的摄食习惯，并对驯化和食物摄入产生巨大影响。
text_zh: 我们的结果表明，社会学习可以促进鳜鱼获得新的摄食习惯，并对驯化和食物摄入产生巨大影响。
text_en: Our results indicate that social learning can promote the acquisition of new feeding habits in mandarin fish and have a significant impact on domestication and food intake.

quote: Our results suggested that the lower expression of the anorexigenic genes pomc and leptin a might facilitate the food intake of dead prey fish in the learning group.
statement: 研究结果表明，学习组中厌食基因pomc和leptin a的表达降低可能促进了对死饵鱼的摄食。
text_zh: 研究结果表明，学习组中厌食基因pomc和leptin a的表达降低可能促进了对死饵鱼的摄食。
text_en: The results indicate that the reduced expression of anorexia genes pomc and leptin a in the learning group may have promoted feeding on dead bait fish.

quote: In the present study, mandarin fish in the LG group showed a higher expression of D3-class receptors (D3/D4R), suggesting that the exposure to the novel fe
statement: 本研究中，学习组（LG）的鳜鱼显示出D3类受体（D3/D4R）表达升高，暗示暴露于新型食物...
text_zh: 本研究中，学习组（LG）的鳜鱼显示出D3类受体（D3/D4R）表达升高，暗示暴露于新型食物...
text_en: In this study, mandarin fish in the learning group (LG) showed elevated expression of D3-type receptors (D3/D4R), suggesting exposure to novel food...
outcome: 神经分子表达与摄食关联
limitations: 引文在句尾截断，信息不完整

quote: 또한 쏘가리 치어를 대상으로 한 단백질요구량 실험에서 단백질 함량이 35~55% 로 증가함에 따라 성장 및 사료효율이 유의하게 높아지는 결과를 나타내어 동일한 결과를 나타내었다
statement: 쏘가리 치어에서 사료 단백질 함량이 35~55%로 증가하면 성장과 사료 효율이 유의하게 높아진다.
text_en: 쏘가리 치어에서 사료 단백질 함량이 35~55%로 증가하면 성장과 사료 효율이 유의하게 높아진다.

quote: It is suggested that the CaMKII signaling pathway activated by social learning could stimulate the expression of the c-fos gene, and then c-fos might be an important transcriptional factor to inhibit the expression of the anorexigenic gene pomc , resulting the increase of food intake of dead prey fish in mandarin fish.
statement: 社会学习激活的CaMKII信号通路可能刺激c-fos基因表达，进而抑制厌食基因pomc的表达，导致鳜鱼对死饵鱼的摄食量增加。
text_zh: 社会学习激活的CaMKII信号通路可能刺激c-fos基因表达，进而抑制厌食基因pomc的表达，导致鳜鱼对死饵鱼的摄食量增加。
text_en: The CaMKII signaling pathway activated by social learning may stimulate c-fos gene expression, thereby inhibiting the expression of the anorexia gene pomc, leading to increased consumption of dead bait fish by mandarin fish.

quote: Fish were maintained in an aquarium (60 × 45 × 45 cm) with a continuous system of water filtration and aeration at constant temperature (25 ± 1 °C).
statement: 鱼在带有连续过滤和曝气系统、恒温（25 ± 1 °C）的水族箱中饲养。
text_zh: 鱼在带有连续过滤和曝气系统、恒温（25 ± 1 °C）的水族箱中饲养。
text_en: Fish were kept in aquaria with continuous filtration and aeration systems, at a constant temperature (25 ± 1 °C).

quote: Fish were acclimated to the condition for 2 weeks prior to experimentation.
statement: 实验前鱼适应该条件两周。
text_zh: 实验前鱼适应该条件两周。
text_en: The fish were acclimated to the conditions for two weeks before the experiment.

quote: Fish were fed once daily at 5:30 pm with live India mrigal Cirrhinus mrigala juvenile.
statement: 鱼每天下午5:30喂食一次活的印度鲮幼鱼。
text_zh: 鱼每天下午5:30喂食一次活的印度鲮幼鱼。
text_en: Fish were fed live Indian carp fry once daily at 5:30 PM.

quote: Based on the current study, the increased success rate of domestication and food intake of dead prey fish could be attributed to the phosphorylation and activation of the PKA and CaMKII signaling pathway.
statement: 本研究表明，鳜鱼驯化成功率及摄食死饵鱼的增加可归因于PKA和CaMKII信号通路的磷酸化和激活。
text_zh: 本研究表明，鳜鱼驯化成功率及摄食死饵鱼的增加可归因于PKA和CaMKII信号通路的磷酸化和激活。
text_en: This study indicates that the increased domestication success rate and consumption of dead bait fish in mandarin fish can be attributed to the phosphorylation and activation of the PKA and CaMKII signaling pathways.
outcome: 摄食行为与驯化适应性

quote: The result was consistent the hypothesis that the inhibition of mTOR signaling might stimulate food intake through changing the translation levels of the anorexigenic Pomc protein in mandarin fish (data not published).
statement: 该结果支持抑制mTOR信号通路可能通过改变厌食性Pomc蛋白的翻译水平来刺激鳜鱼摄食的假设。
text_zh: 该结果支持抑制mTOR信号通路可能通过改变厌食性Pomc蛋白的翻译水平来刺激鳜鱼摄食的假设。
text_en: This result supports the hypothesis that inhibiting the mTOR signaling pathway may stimulate feeding in mandarin fish by altering the translation levels of anorexigenic Pomc protein.

quote: Our results showed that with the positive demonstration fish that feed on the dead prey fish, mandarin fish also could accept the dead prey fish with a higher success rate and lower learning times than those with the negative demonstration fish.
statement: 使用摄食死饵鱼的阳性示范鱼时，鳜鱼接受死饵鱼的成功率更高且学习次数更少。
text_zh: 使用摄食死饵鱼的阳性示范鱼时，鳜鱼接受死饵鱼的成功率更高且学习次数更少。
text_en: When using positive demonstrator fish that feed on dead baitfish, the success rate of mandarin fish accepting dead baitfish is higher and the number of learning trials is lower.

quote: The social learning of acquiring new feeding habits in mandarin fish could be attributed to the expression of learning and appetite control genes, as well as the activation of the CaMKII signaling pathway.
statement: 鳜鱼通过社会学习获取新摄食习惯可归因于学习和食欲控制基因的表达以及CaMKII信号通路的激活。
text_zh: 鳜鱼通过社会学习获取新摄食习惯可归因于学习和食欲控制基因的表达以及CaMKII信号通路的激活。
text_en: The acquisition of new feeding habits by Chinese perch through social learning can be attributed to the expression of learning and appetite control genes and the activation of the CaMKII signaling pathway.

quote: As such, the c-fos gene might be an important transcriptional factor to inhibit the expression of the anorexigenic gene pomc , resulting in an increase of the food intake of dead prey fish in mandarin fish.
statement: c-fos基因可能作为重要的转录因子抑制厌食基因pomc的表达，从而增加鳜鱼对死饵鱼的摄入量。
text_zh: c-fos基因可能作为重要的转录因子抑制厌食基因pomc的表达，从而增加鳜鱼对死饵鱼的摄入量。
text_en: The c-fos gene may act as an important transcription factor to inhibit the expression of the anorexia gene pomc, thereby increasing the intake of dead bait fish by mandarin fish.

quote: our experiment encourages further studies on the potential roles of social learning in the context of feeding training in fish, especially for large-scale aquaculture purpose.
statement: 实验鼓励进一步研究社会学习在鱼类摄食训练中的潜在作用，特别是用于大规模水产养殖目的。
text_zh: 实验鼓励进一步研究社会学习在鱼类摄食训练中的潜在作用，特别是用于大规模水产养殖目的。
text_en: The study encourages further research on the potential role of social learning in fish feeding training, particularly for large-scale aquaculture purposes.

quote: During the test period, mandarin fish were fed with prey fish 10 times (2 min per time) at 5:30 pm each day over a 12 day period.
statement: 在测试期间，鳜鱼每天下午5:30喂食猎物鱼10次，每次2分钟，持续12天。
text_zh: 在测试期间，鳜鱼每天下午5:30喂食猎物鱼10次，每次2分钟，持续12天。
text_en: During the test period, mandarin fish were fed prey fish 10 times daily at 5:30 PM, for 2 minutes each time, lasting 12 days.

quote: As long as one dead prey fish was successfully accepted, the experimental fish was marked as a successful transformer of feeding habits to dead prey fish.
statement: 只要成功接受一条死饵鱼，实验鱼即被标记为成功转变摄食习惯至死饵鱼。
text_zh: 只要成功接受一条死饵鱼，实验鱼即被标记为成功转变摄食习惯至死饵鱼。
text_en: An experimental fish was marked as having successfully shifted its feeding habit to dead baitfish if it successfully accepted a single dead baitfish.

quote: No mandarin fish died of natural causes during the testing.
statement: 在测试期间没有鳜鱼因自然原因死亡。
text_zh: 在测试期间没有鳜鱼因自然原因死亡。
text_en: No mandarin fish died of natural causes during the test period.

quote: The experimental fish ( n = 12) were anesthetized with MS-222 (Argent Chemical Laboratories, Redmond, WA, USA) (200 mg L −1 ), and euthanized by decapitation at 2 h after feeding.
statement: 实验鱼使用MS-222麻醉，并在喂食后2小时通过断头处死。
text_zh: 实验鱼使用MS-222麻醉，并在喂食后2小时通过断头处死。
text_en: Experimental fish were anesthetized with MS-222 and euthanized by decapitation 2 hours after feeding.

quote: Siniperca chuatsi rhabdovirus (SCRV) is an important pathogen that seriously harms aquaculture industry and has a high mortality in Chinese perch ( Siniperca chuatsi ; He et al., 1998 ; Wu et al., 2007 ).
statement: 鳜鱼弹状病毒（SCRV）是一种严重危害水产养殖业的重要病原体，会导致鳜鱼高死亡率。
text_zh: 鳜鱼弹状病毒（SCRV）是一种严重危害水产养殖业的重要病原体，会导致鳜鱼高死亡率。
text_en: Siniperca chuatsi rhabdovirus (SCRV) is an important pathogen that seriously harms the aquaculture industry and causes high mortality in mandarin fish.

quote: Previous study results showed that G protein DNA vaccine can produce higher immune protection against SCRV disease ( Chen et al., 2009 , 2012 ).
statement: 先前的研究结果表明，G蛋白DNA疫苗可以对SCRV疾病产生更高的免疫保护。
text_zh: 先前的研究结果表明，G蛋白DNA疫苗可以对SCRV疾病产生更高的免疫保护。
text_en: Previous research results indicate that the G protein DNA vaccine can provide higher immune protection against SCRV disease.

quote: Replication of SCRV is highly dependent on levels of the asparagine, and inhibition of a key enzyme involved in asparagine synthesis results in a severe weakening of viral replication.
statement: SCRV的复制高度依赖于天冬酰胺水平，抑制参与天冬酰胺合成的关键酶会导致病毒复制严重减弱。
text_zh: SCRV的复制高度依赖于天冬酰胺水平，抑制参与天冬酰胺合成的关键酶会导致病毒复制严重减弱。
text_en: SCRV replication is highly dependent on asparagine levels; inhibiting key enzymes involved in asparagine synthesis leads to severely reduced viral replication.

population.species: CPB (鲤春病毒血症相关细胞)

quote: These findings suggest that the key enzymes of aspartic acid metabolism pathway may be a new target to effectively control SCRV infection, providing a new idea for the treatment strategy of SCRV disease.
statement: 这些发现表明天冬氨酸代谢途径的关键酶可能是有效控制SCRV感染的新靶点，为SCRV疾病的治疗策略提供了新思路。
text_zh: 这些发现表明天冬氨酸代谢途径的关键酶可能是有效控制SCRV感染的新靶点，为SCRV疾病的治疗策略提供了新思路。
text_en: These findings suggest that key enzymes in the aspartate metabolic pathway may be new targets for effectively controlling SCRV infection, providing new ideas for treatment strategies for SCRV disease.

population.species: CPB (鲤春病毒血症相关细胞)

quote: A low level of oxygen or hypoxia is a common physiological and pathological phenomenon that can elicit stress responses and even inflict damage to organisms
statement: 低氧水平或缺氧是一种生理和病理现象，可引发应激反应甚至对生物体造成损害。
text_zh: 低氧水平或缺氧是一种生理和病理现象，可引发应激反应甚至对生物体造成损害。
text_en: Hypoxia or anoxia is a physiological and pathological phenomenon that can trigger stress responses and even cause damage to organisms.

quote: Hypoxic stress often occurs in aquaculture environments.
statement: 缺氧胁迫经常发生在养殖环境中。
text_zh: 缺氧胁迫经常发生在养殖环境中。
text_en: Hypoxia stress frequently occurs in aquaculture environments.

quote: Our results showed that the addition of AOAA inhibited the production of SCRV virus and the expression of viral proteins, but the mechanism of its action in virus replication and proliferation needs further study.
statement: 本研究结果显示，添加AOAA抑制了SCRV病毒的产生和病毒蛋白的表达，但其对病毒复制和增殖的作用机制需要进一步研究。
text_zh: 本研究结果显示，添加AOAA抑制了SCRV病毒的产生和病毒蛋白的表达，但其对病毒复制和增殖的作用机制需要进一步研究。
text_en: The results of this study showed that adding AOAA inhibited SCRV virus production and viral protein expression, but its mechanism of action on virus replication and proliferation requires further research.

quote: The excessively high breeding density and the excessive bait feeding amount led to hypoxia
statement: 过高的养殖密度和过多的饵料投喂量导致了缺氧。
text_zh: 过高的养殖密度和过多的饵料投喂量导致了缺氧。
text_en: Excessively high farming density and excessive feed input led to hypoxia.
outcome: 水体溶解氧水平/缺氧胁迫

quote: Aquatic animals living in hypoxic environments must adapt to this condition to survive, and many important types of economic fish are highly intolerant of a low-oxygen environment, causing huge economic losses to aquaculture
statement: 许多重要的经济鱼类对低氧环境高度不耐受，导致水产养殖遭受巨大经济损失。
text_zh: 许多重要的经济鱼类对低氧环境高度不耐受，导致水产养殖遭受巨大经济损失。
text_en: Many economically important fish species are highly intolerant of hypoxic environments, leading to huge economic losses in aquaculture.

quote: They were bred in a laboratory recirculating fresh-water system for 2 weeks to acclimatize, and the water temperature was maintained at 27 °C.
statement: 鱼在实验室循环淡水系统中饲养2周以适应环境，水温保持在27°C。
text_zh: 鱼在实验室循环淡水系统中饲养2周以适应环境，水温保持在27°C。
text_en: Fish were acclimated for 2 weeks in a laboratory recirculating freshwater system, with the water temperature maintained at 27°C.

quote: Fish were anaesthetized with MS-222 (40 mg/L, Sigma–Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA) for tissue sampling.
statement: 为了进行组织采样，使用MS-222（40 mg/L）对鱼进行麻醉。
text_zh: 为了进行组织采样，使用MS-222（40 mg/L）对鱼进行麻醉。
text_en: For tissue sampling, fish were anesthetized using MS-222 (40 mg/L).

quote: With increased breeding density, the phenomenon of hypoxia gradually increases in aquaculture.
statement: 养殖密度的增加导致水产养殖中缺氧现象逐渐增多。
text_zh: 养殖密度的增加导致水产养殖中缺氧现象逐渐增多。
text_en: Increasing farming density leads to a gradual increase in hypoxia phenomena in aquaculture.

quote: Many farmed fishes, especially those in early developmental stages, are exposed to anoxic environments due to high density, excessive feeding, and inappropriate management [ 39 ].
statement: 许多养殖鱼类，特别是处于早期发育阶段的鱼类，由于高密度、过度投喂和管理不当而暴露于无氧环境。
text_zh: 许多养殖鱼类，特别是处于早期发育阶段的鱼类，由于高密度、过度投喂和管理不当而暴露于无氧环境。
text_en: Many farmed fish, especially those in early developmental stages, are exposed to anoxic environments due to high density, overfeeding, and improper management.

quote: Beyond applications in human disease and genotype detection, this detection technology has been widely applied in various fields such as agriculture, animal husbandry, and aquaculture for the detection of numerous pathogens.
statement: 该检测技术已广泛应用于农业、畜牧业和水产养殖等领域，用于检测多种病原体。
text_zh: 该检测技术已广泛应用于农业、畜牧业和水产养殖等领域，用于检测多种病原体。
text_en: This detection technology has been widely applied in agriculture, animal husbandry, and aquaculture for detecting multiple pathogens.

quote: Examples include potato virus Y ( He et al., 2022 ), African swine fever virus (ASFV) ( Mao et al., 2023 ), grouper nervous necrosis virus ( Huang et al., 2022 ), and infectious hematopoietic necrosis virus ( Rong et al., 2024 ).
statement: 应用实例包括马铃薯Y病毒、非洲猪瘟病毒、石斑鱼神经坏死病毒和传染性造血器官坏死病毒。
text_zh: 应用实例包括马铃薯Y病毒、非洲猪瘟病毒、石斑鱼神经坏死病毒和传染性造血器官坏死病毒。
text_en: Application examples include Potato virus Y, African swine fever virus, grouper nervous necrosis virus, and infectious hematopoietic necrosis virus.

quote: Their excellent detection capabilities are of great significance for disease prevention.
statement: 其优异的检测能力对疾病预防具有重要意义。
text_zh: 其优异的检测能力对疾病预防具有重要意义。
text_en: Its excellent detection capability is of great significance for disease prevention.

quote: In this study, we achieved a rapid, sensitive, and visual detection of MRV and ISKNV using the RPA-CRISPR/Cas system.
statement: 本研究利用RPA-CRISPR/Cas系统实现了对MRV和ISKNV的快速、灵敏且可视化的检测。
text_zh: 本研究利用RPA-CRISPR/Cas系统实现了对MRV和ISKNV的快速、灵敏且可视化的检测。
text_en: This study used the RPA-CRISPR/Cas system to achieve rapid, sensitive, and visual detection of MRV and ISKNV.

quote: This approach offers a potent tool for the prompt diagnosis of these aquatic pathogens, aiding in the prevention and control of MRV and ISKNV diseases.
statement: 该方法为这些水生病原体的及时诊断提供了有力工具，有助于MRV和ISKNV疾病的预防和控制。
text_zh: 该方法为这些水生病原体的及时诊断提供了有力工具，有助于MRV和ISKNV疾病的预防和控制。
text_en: This method provides a powerful tool for the timely diagnosis of these aquatic pathogens, aiding in the prevention and control of MRV and ISKNV diseases.

quote: These samples were subsequently tested using our established RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a detection system.
statement: 这些样本随后使用已建立的RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a检测系统进行了测试。
text_zh: 这些样本随后使用已建立的RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a检测系统进行了测试。
text_en: These samples were subsequently tested using the established RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a detection system.

quote: In conclusion, a field-suitable detection method for ISKNV and MRV has been established, providing a powerful tool for the prompt diagnosis of these aquatic pathogens and aiding in the prevention and control of ISKNV and MRV diseases.
statement: 已建立一种适用于现场检测ISKNV和MRV的方法，为这些水生病原体的快速诊断提供了有力工具，并有助于ISKNV和MRV疾病的预防和控制。
text_zh: 已建立一种适用于现场检测ISKNV和MRV的方法，为这些水生病原体的快速诊断提供了有力工具，并有助于ISKNV和MRV疾病的预防和控制。
text_en: A method suitable for on-site detection of ISKNV and MRV has been established, providing a powerful tool for the rapid diagnosis of these aquatic pathogens and contributing to the prevention and control of ISKNV and MRV diseases.

quote: Iridoviruses are significant causative agents of outbreaks in cultured fish, and they are among the most widespread and pathogenic viral pathogens affecting farmed fish species ( Leiva-Rebollo et al., 2024 ).
statement: 虹彩病毒是养殖鱼类爆发的重要致病因子，也是影响养殖鱼类物种中最广泛和最具致病性的病毒病原体之一。
text_zh: 虹彩病毒是养殖鱼类爆发的重要致病因子，也是影响养殖鱼类物种中最广泛和最具致病性的病毒病原体之一。
text_en: Iridovirus is an important pathogenic factor in outbreaks of farmed fish, and is one of the most widespread and pathogenic viral pathogens affecting farmed fish species.

quote: Notably, the mandarin fish ranavirus (MRV) and the infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV) are noteworthy due to their endemicity and high pathogenicity, posing a significant threat to aquaculture.
statement: 值得注意的是，鳜鱼蛙病毒（MRV）和传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV）因其地方性流行和高致病性而备受关注，对水产养殖构成重大威胁。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，鳜鱼蛙病毒（MRV）和传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV）因其地方性流行和高致病性而备受关注，对水产养殖构成重大威胁。
text_en: It is worth noting that Mandarinfish ranavirus (MRV) and infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV) have attracted attention due to their endemic prevalence and high pathogenicity, posing a major threat to aquaculture.

quote: Currently, methods such as nested PCR, real-time PCR, and microscopic examination are typically used for the detection and identification of MRV and ISKNV ( Fu et al., 2020 ; Cao et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ).
statement: 目前，巢式PCR、实时PCR和显微镜检查等方法通常用于MRV和ISKNV的检测和鉴定。
text_zh: 目前，巢式PCR、实时PCR和显微镜检查等方法通常用于MRV和ISKNV的检测和鉴定。
text_en: Currently, methods such as nested PCR, real-time PCR, and microscopic examination are commonly used for the detection and identification of MRV and ISKNV.
intervention: Nested PCR, real-time PCR and microscopy

quote: Therefore, the development of novel, rapid virus detection technologies is crucial for preventing and controlling MRV and ISKNV diseases.
statement: 因此，开发新型、快速的病毒检测技术对于预防和控制MRV和ISKNV疾病至关重要。
text_zh: 因此，开发新型、快速的病毒检测技术对于预防和控制MRV和ISKNV疾病至关重要。
text_en: Therefore, developing new and rapid virus detection technologies is crucial for the prevention and control of MRV and ISKNV diseases.

quote: These results indicated that our method could detect as low as 1 copy/μL of MRV and 0.1 copy/μL of ISKNV.
statement: 这些结果表明该方法可检测低至1 copy/μL的MRV和0.1 copy/μL的ISKNV。
text_zh: 这些结果表明该方法可检测低至1 copy/μL的MRV和0.1 copy/μL的ISKNV。
text_en: These results indicate that this method can detect MRV at levels as low as 1 copy/μL and ISKNV at levels as low as 0.1 copy/μL.

quote: In aquaculture, Fei et al. establishes an infectious hematopoietic necrosis virus detection system with 9.5 copies/μL sensitivity ( Rong et al., 2024 ), while Thanwarat Sukonta et al. achieves high-sensitivity detection of scale drop disease virus at 40 copies per reaction ( Sukonta et al., 2022 ).
statement: 在水产养殖中，Fei等人建立了传染性造血器官坏死病毒检测系统，灵敏度为9.5 copies/μL；Thanwarat Sukonta等人实现了鳞片脱落病病毒的高灵敏度检测，达到每反应40个拷贝。
text_zh: 在水产养殖中，Fei等人建立了传染性造血器官坏死病毒检测系统，灵敏度为9.5 copies/μL；Thanwarat Sukonta等人实现了鳞片脱落病病毒的高灵敏度检测，达到每反应40个拷贝。
text_en: In aquaculture, Fei et al. established an infectious hematopoietic necrosis virus detection system with a sensitivity of 9.5 copies/μL; Thanwarat Sukonta et al. achieved high-sensitivity detection of scale loss disease virus, reaching 40 copies per reaction.

quote: Based on the powerful amplification capability of RPA and the high specificity of the CRISPR/Cas system, we designed and established a detection system for the widely prevalent ISKNV and MRV viruses ( Figure 8 ).
statement: 基于RPA强大的扩增能力和CRISPR/Cas系统的高特异性，作者设计并建立了一种针对广泛流行的ISKNV和MRV病毒的检测系统。
text_zh: 基于RPA强大的扩增能力和CRISPR/Cas系统的高特异性，作者设计并建立了一种针对广泛流行的ISKNV和MRV病毒的检测系统。
text_en: Based on the powerful amplification capability of RPA and the high specificity of the CRISPR/Cas system, the authors designed and established a detection system for the widely prevalent ISKNV and MRV viruses.

quote: Overall, we have designed and established a CRISPR/Cas12a-based detection system targeting the widely prevalent ISKNV and MRV viruses.
statement: 研究设计并建立了一种针对ISKNV和MRV病毒的CRISPR/Cas12a检测系统。
text_zh: 研究设计并建立了一种针对ISKNV和MRV病毒的CRISPR/Cas12a检测系统。
text_en: A CRISPR/Cas12a detection system targeting ISKNV and MRV viruses was designed and established.

quote: This enables on-site detection, facilitating timely diagnosis and the implementation of appropriate control measures.
statement: 这实现了现场检测，有助于及时诊断和实施适当的控制措施。
text_zh: 这实现了现场检测，有助于及时诊断和实施适当的控制措施。
text_en: This enables on-site detection, which helps in timely diagnosis and implementation of appropriate control measures.

quote: In this study, we developed a rapid, sensitive, and visual detection method for MRV and ISKNV using the recombinase polymerase amplification (RPA)−CRISPR/Cas12a system.
statement: 本研究开发了一种使用重组酶聚合酶扩增（RPA）-CRISPR/Cas12a系统快速、灵敏且可视化的检测MRV和ISKNV的方法。
text_zh: 本研究开发了一种使用重组酶聚合酶扩增（RPA）-CRISPR/Cas12a系统快速、灵敏且可视化的检测MRV和ISKNV的方法。
text_en: This study developed a method for the rapid, sensitive, and visual detection of MRV and ISKNV using a recombinase polymerase amplification (RPA)-CRISPR/Cas12a system.

quote: This method can detect as low as 1 copy/μL of MRV and 0.1 copy/μL of ISKNV, demonstrating excellent specificity and reproducibility.
statement: 该方法可检测到低至1拷贝/μL的MRV和0.1拷贝/μL的ISKNV，表现出优异的特异性和重复性。
text_zh: 该方法可检测到低至1拷贝/μL的MRV和0.1拷贝/μL的ISKNV，表现出优异的特异性和重复性。
text_en: This method can detect MRV as low as 1 copy/μL and ISKNV as low as 0.1 copy/μL, showing excellent specificity and repeatability.

quote: Sensitivity evaluation demonstrated our system could detect as low as 1 copy/μL of MRV and 0.1 copy/μL of ISKNV, indicating its potential for early detection and intervention.
statement: 灵敏度评估表明该系统可检测到低至1拷贝/μL的MRV和0.1拷贝/μL的ISKNV，显示了其早期检测和干预的潜力。
text_zh: 灵敏度评估表明该系统可检测到低至1拷贝/μL的MRV和0.1拷贝/μL的ISKNV，显示了其早期检测和干预的潜力。
text_en: Sensitivity assessment showed that the system can detect MRV as low as 1 copy/μL and ISKNV as low as 0.1 copy/μL, demonstrating its potential for early detection and intervention.

quote: In the cultivation of economically valuable fish, disease surveillance becomes critical, as early detection of viral infections allows for swift control measures.
statement: 在经济价值鱼类的养殖中，疾病监测变得至关重要，因为早期检测病毒感染允许采取迅速的控制措施。
text_zh: 在经济价值鱼类的养殖中，疾病监测变得至关重要，因为早期检测病毒感染允许采取迅速的控制措施。
text_en: In the farming of economically valuable fish, disease monitoring becomes crucial because early detection of viral infections allows for rapid control measures.

quote: For example, qPCR can detect ISKNV at a sensitivity of 7 copies/μL ( Cao et al., 2024 ).
statement: 例如，qPCR可以以7拷贝/微升的灵敏度检测ISKNV。
text_zh: 例如，qPCR可以以7拷贝/微升的灵敏度检测ISKNV。
text_en: For example, qPCR can detect ISKNV with a sensitivity of 7 copies/microliter.

quote: This, in turn, could enhance β-oxidation of long-chain fatty acids, ultimately improving intestinal digestive function and systemic lipid metabolic homeostasis.
statement: 这种基因表达的上调进而可能增强长链脂肪酸的β-氧化，最终改善肠道消化功能和全身脂质代谢稳态。
text_zh: 这种基因表达的上调进而可能增强长链脂肪酸的β-氧化，最终改善肠道消化功能和全身脂质代谢稳态。
text_en: This upregulation of gene expression may subsequently enhance the β-oxidation of long-chain fatty acids, ultimately improving intestinal digestive function and systemic lipid metabolic homeostasis.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯
outcome: 肠道消化功能与脂质代谢

quote: For aquaculture viruses, LAMP-based detection methods for largemouth bass virus have achieved a sensitivity of 8.55 copies/μL ( Zhu et al., 2020 )
statement: 对于水产养殖病毒，基于LAMP的大口黑鲈病毒检测方法已达到8.55 copies/μL的灵敏度。
text_zh: 对于水产养殖病毒，基于LAMP的大口黑鲈病毒检测方法已达到8.55 copies/μL的灵敏度。
text_en: For aquaculture viruses, the LAMP-based detection method for largemouth bass virus has achieved a sensitivity of 8.55 copies/μL.

quote: while the recombinase-aided amplification (RAA) system reaches 89 copies/μL ( Zhu et al., 2022 ).
statement: 重组酶辅助扩增（RAA）系统达到89 copies/μL。
text_zh: 重组酶辅助扩增（RAA）系统达到89 copies/μL。
text_en: The recombinase-aided amplification (RAA) system reached 89 copies/μL.

quote: Existing LAMP-lateral flow dipstick systems for ISKNV detection have attained a sensitivity of 10 copies/μL ( Ding et al., 2010 ).
statement: 现有的用于ISKNV检测的LAMP侧流试纸条系统已达到10 copies/μL的灵敏度。
text_zh: 现有的用于ISKNV检测的LAMP侧流试纸条系统已达到10 copies/μL的灵敏度。
text_en: The existing LAMP lateral flow dipstick system for ISKNV detection has reached a sensitivity of 10 copies/μL.

quote: Tributyrin (TB), as a novel feed additive, holds broad market prospects and is crucial for promoting fish growth and maintaining intestinal health.
statement: 三丁酸甘油酯作为一种新型饲料添加剂，对促进鱼类生长和维持肠道健康至关重要。
text_zh: 三丁酸甘油酯作为一种新型饲料添加剂，对促进鱼类生长和维持肠道健康至关重要。
text_en: Tributyrin, as a novel feed additive, is crucial for promoting fish growth and maintaining gut health.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: The control group (C) received only the standard extruded feed, while the experimental groups were supplemented with tributyrin (TB) at concentrations of 500 mg/kg (T1 group) and 1000 mg/kg (T2 group), respectively.
statement: 对照组仅喂食标准膨化饲料，实验组分别补充浓度为500 mg/kg和1000 mg/kg的三丁酸甘油酯。
text_zh: 对照组仅喂食标准膨化饲料，实验组分别补充浓度为500 mg/kg和1000 mg/kg的三丁酸甘油酯。
text_en: The control group was fed only standard extruded feed, while the experimental groups were supplemented with tributyrin at concentrations of 500 mg/kg and 1000 mg/kg.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: Tissue distribution and intestinal enzyme activity analyses revealed that supplementation with varying concentrations of TB upregulates cpt1b gene expression in different tissues, while modulating intestinal digestive enzyme and antioxidant enzyme activities.
statement: 组织分布和肠道酶活性分析表明，不同浓度的三丁酸甘油酯补充剂上调了不同组织中cpt1b基因的表达，同时调节了肠道消化酶和抗氧化酶的活性。
text_zh: 组织分布和肠道酶活性分析表明，不同浓度的三丁酸甘油酯补充剂上调了不同组织中cpt1b基因的表达，同时调节了肠道消化酶和抗氧化酶的活性。
text_en: Tissue distribution and intestinal enzyme activity analysis showed that tributyrin supplementation at different concentrations upregulated the expression of the cpt1b gene in different tissues, while modulating the activity of intestinal digestive enzymes and antioxidant enzymes.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: To evaluate the efficacy of our established RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a detection system, we collected eight gut tissue samples from diseased mandarin fish at the Hengxing Aquaculture Farm in Guangzhou, China.
statement: 为了评估建立的RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a检测系统的功效，从中国广州恒兴水产养殖场的患病鳜鱼中收集了八份肠道组织样本。
text_zh: 为了评估建立的RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a检测系统的功效，从中国广州恒兴水产养殖场的患病鳜鱼中收集了八份肠道组织样本。
text_en: To evaluate the efficacy of the established RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a detection system, eight intestinal tissue samples were collected from diseased mandarin fish at the Hengxing Aquaculture Farm in Guangzhou, China.

quote: For MRV detection, the first round of nested PCR did not detect any positive, but the second round identified MRV in sample 8 ( Figure 7A ). Using the RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a detection system, we directly observed strong fluorescence in sample 8, aligning with the nested PCR results ( Figure 7B ).
statement: 在MRV检测中，巢式PCR第一轮未检测到阳性，但第二轮在样本8中识别出MRV；使用RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a检测系统在样本8中直接观察到强荧光，与巢式PCR结果一致。
text_zh: 在MRV检测中，巢式PCR第一轮未检测到阳性，但第二轮在样本8中识别出MRV；使用RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a检测系统在样本8中直接观察到强荧光，与巢式PCR结果一致。
text_en: In MRV detection, the first round of nested PCR did not detect a positive result, but the second round identified MRV in sample 8; using the RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a detection system, strong fluorescence was directly observed in sample 8, consistent with the nested PCR results.

quote: The control group (C) received only the standard extruded feed, while the experimental groups were supplemented with tributyrin (TB) at concentrations of 500 mg/kg (T1 group) and 1000 mg/kg (T2 group), respectively, then administered twice daily (7:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m.).
statement: 实验组在标准膨化饲料中分别添加了500 mg/kg和1000 mg/kg的三丁酸甘油酯，并每日两次投喂。
text_zh: 实验组在标准膨化饲料中分别添加了500 mg/kg和1000 mg/kg的三丁酸甘油酯，并每日两次投喂。
text_en: The experimental groups were fed standard extruded feed supplemented with tributyrin at 500 mg/kg and 1000 mg/kg, respectively, twice daily.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: Throughout the rearing period, water quality parameters were maintained as follows: temperature at 25 ± 1 °C, pH 7.8–8.2, and dissolved oxygen ≥ 5.0 mg/L.
statement: 在整个养殖期间，水质参数被维持在温度25±1°C、pH 7.8-8.2以及溶解氧≥5.0 mg/L的水平。
text_zh: 在整个养殖期间，水质参数被维持在温度25±1°C、pH 7.8-8.2以及溶解氧≥5.0 mg/L的水平。
text_en: Throughout the entire farming period, water quality parameters were maintained at a temperature of 25±1°C, pH 7.8-8.2, and dissolved oxygen ≥5.0 mg/L.

quote: After two months of feeding, five fish from each group were randomly selected and dissected following anesthesia with MS-222 (100 mg/L; Cat. D0063637, Shanghai Amperexperiment Technology Co., Anpel, Shanghai, China).
statement: 喂养两个月后，从每组随机选取五条鱼，使用MS-222（100 mg/L）进行麻醉后解剖。
text_zh: 喂养两个月后，从每组随机选取五条鱼，使用MS-222（100 mg/L）进行麻醉后解剖。
text_en: After two months of feeding, five fish were randomly selected from each group and dissected after anesthesia with MS-222 (100 mg/L).
outcome: 操作应激与安乐死/取样处理

quote: Results indicated that TB positively regulated digestive enzyme and antioxidant enzyme activities in mandarin fish, with effects varying by additional concentration.
statement: TB positively regulated digestive enzyme and antioxidant enzyme activities in mandarin fish, with effects varying by concentration.
text_en: TB positively regulated digestive enzyme and antioxidant enzyme activities in mandarin fish, with effects varying by concentration.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯
outcome: digestive enzyme and antioxidant enzyme activities

quote: Adding different concentrations (T1, T2) of TB significantly influenced both AMS and T-SOD in mandarin fish, with the differences in enzyme activity becoming more pronounced as the added concentration increased.
statement: 添加不同浓度（T1，T2）的TB显著影响了鳜鱼的AMS和T-SOD，且随着添加浓度的增加，酶活性的差异变得更加明显。
text_zh: 添加不同浓度（T1，T2）的TB显著影响了鳜鱼的AMS和T-SOD，且随着添加浓度的增加，酶活性的差异变得更加明显。
text_en: Adding different concentrations (T1, T2) of TB significantly affected the AMS and T-SOD of mandarin fish, and the difference in enzyme activity became more pronounced as the addition concentration increased.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: This proposed regulatory mechanism requires experimental validation.
statement: The proposed regulatory mechanism regarding TB's effect on intestinal function and lipid metabolism requires further experimental validation.
text_en: The proposed regulatory mechanism regarding TB's effect on intestinal function and lipid metabolism requires further experimental validation.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: The fish were evenly allocated into three groups and reared in net cages (1.5 m × 1.5 m × 1.2 m), one hundred fish per group ( n = 100), with mandarin fish extruded feed provided throughout an eight-week trial period.
statement: Fish were housed in net cages at a density of 100 fish per cage and fed extruded feed for eight weeks.
text_en: Fish were housed in net cages at a density of 100 fish per cage and fed extruded feed for eight weeks.

quote: In fish, multiple studies have indicated that butyric acid can enhance growth performance, improve intestinal health, and boost non-specific immunity
statement: 多项研究表明，丁酸可以增强鱼类的生长性能、改善肠道健康并提高非特异性免疫力。
text_zh: 多项研究表明，丁酸可以增强鱼类的生长性能、改善肠道健康并提高非特异性免疫力。
text_en: Multiple studies have shown that butyric acid can enhance the growth performance of fish, improve gut health, and increase non-specific immunity.
outcome: 生长性能、肠道健康及免疫状态

quote: To address this industry challenge, butyrate salts have been added to feed as an alternative. However, these salts are prone to deliquescence, which impedes their widespread use
statement: 为应对这一行业挑战，丁酸盐被作为替代品添加到饲料中。然而，这些盐类容易潮解，阻碍了其广泛使用。
text_zh: 为应对这一行业挑战，丁酸盐被作为替代品添加到饲料中。然而，这些盐类容易潮解，阻碍了其广泛使用。
text_en: To address this industry challenge, butyrates were added to feed as a substitute. However, these salts are prone to deliquescence, which hinders their widespread use.
outcome: 饲料稳定性及储存特性

quote: Tributyrin (TB), a butyric acid precursor composed of N -butyric acid and glycerol, has emerged as an effective solution.
statement: 三丁酸甘油酯（TB），一种由N-丁酸和甘油组成的丁酸前体，已成为一种有效的解决方案。
text_zh: 三丁酸甘油酯（TB），一种由N-丁酸和甘油组成的丁酸前体，已成为一种有效的解决方案。
text_en: Tributyrin (TB), a butyrate precursor composed of N-butyric acid and glycerol, has become an effective solution.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯
outcome: 解决丁酸应用局限性的替代方案

quote: Mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi ), a typical carnivorous species, naturally preys on live baitfish but can be gradually domesticated to accept formulated artificial feed [ 3 ].
statement: 鳜鱼是典型的肉食性物种，自然捕食活饵鱼，但可以通过驯化逐渐接受配合人工饲料。
text_zh: 鳜鱼是典型的肉食性物种，自然捕食活饵鱼，但可以通过驯化逐渐接受配合人工饲料。
text_en: Mandarin fish is a typical carnivorous species that naturally preys on live baitfish, but can gradually accept formulated artificial feed through domestication.

quote: However, formulated feeds contain ingredients such as starch and plant proteins that are difficult for carnivorous fish to fully digest, and they differ substantially from live baitfish in nutritional composition.
statement: 然而，配合饲料含有淀粉和植物蛋白等肉食性鱼类难以完全消化的成分，且在营养成分上与活饵鱼存在显著差异。
text_zh: 然而，配合饲料含有淀粉和植物蛋白等肉食性鱼类难以完全消化的成分，且在营养成分上与活饵鱼存在显著差异。
text_en: However, formulated feed contains components such as starch and plant protein that carnivorous fish cannot fully digest, and it differs significantly from live bait fish in nutritional composition.

quote: These differences may impair growth performance and even affect overall fish health.
statement: 这些差异可能会损害生长性能，甚至影响鱼类的整体健康。
text_zh: 这些差异可能会损害生长性能，甚至影响鱼类的整体健康。
text_en: These differences may impair growth performance and even affect the overall health of fish.

quote: Studies have shown that under formulated feeding regimes, both hybrid mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi × Siniperca scherzeri ) and mandarin fish exhibit slowed growth rates [ 5 ], reduced thickness of the gastric submucosal and muscular layers, decreased branching of intestinal villi, and diminished intestinal protease activity [ 4 , 6 ].
statement: 研究表明，在配合饲料喂养制度下，杂交鳜鱼和鳜鱼均表现出生长速率减慢、胃黏膜下层和肌层厚度降低、肠绒毛分支减少以及肠道蛋白酶活性下降。
text_zh: 研究表明，在配合饲料喂养制度下，杂交鳜鱼和鳜鱼均表现出生长速率减慢、胃黏膜下层和肌层厚度降低、肠绒毛分支减少以及肠道蛋白酶活性下降。
text_en: Studies have shown that under a formulated feed feeding regime, both hybrid mandarin fish and mandarin fish exhibited slowed growth rates, reduced thickness of the gastric submucosa and muscularis layers, decreased intestinal villus branching, and reduced intestinal protease activity.

population.species: 杂交鳜鱼 (Siniperca chuatsi × Siniperca scherzeri), 鳜鱼 (Siniperca chuatsi)

outcome: 生长速率与肠道结构/功能

quote: To improve this situation, butyric acid has attracted considerable attention as a vital energy source for intestinal epithelial cells, promoting intestinal development and thereby enhancing feed digestion and absorption [ 7 , 8 ].
statement: 为了改善这种情况，丁酸作为一种重要的肠上皮细胞能量来源引起了广泛关注，它能促进肠道发育，从而增强饲料的消化吸收。
text_zh: 为了改善这种情况，丁酸作为一种重要的肠上皮细胞能量来源引起了广泛关注，它能促进肠道发育，从而增强饲料的消化吸收。
text_en: To improve this situation, butyrate has attracted widespread attention as an important energy source for intestinal epithelial cells; it promotes intestinal development, thereby enhancing feed digestion and absorption.

population.species: 一般性描述（隐含针对前述问题）

quote: The addition of TB to feed can regulate the expression of the lipid metabolism-related gene cpt1b in mandarin fish, improving the activity of intestinal digestive enzymes and antioxidant enzymes and thereby maintaining intestinal health.
statement: 在饲料中添加TB可以调节鳜鱼脂质代谢相关基因cpt1b的表达，提高肠道消化酶和抗氧化酶的活性，从而维持肠道健康。
text_zh: 在饲料中添加TB可以调节鳜鱼脂质代谢相关基因cpt1b的表达，提高肠道消化酶和抗氧化酶的活性，从而维持肠道健康。
text_en: Adding TB to feed can regulate the expression of the lipid metabolism-related gene cpt1b in mandarin fish, increase the activity of intestinal digestive enzymes and antioxidant enzymes, thereby maintaining gut health.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: TB may also support intestinal health by enhancing antioxidant enzyme activity and attenuating intestinal inflammatory responses, thereby establishing a stable intestinal microenvironment conducive to nutrient absorption and lipid metabolism regulation.
statement: TB可能通过增强抗氧化酶活性和减轻肠道炎症反应来支持肠道健康，从而建立有利于营养吸收和脂质代谢调节的稳定肠道微环境。
text_zh: TB可能通过增强抗氧化酶活性和减轻肠道炎症反应来支持肠道健康，从而建立有利于营养吸收和脂质代谢调节的稳定肠道微环境。
text_en: TB may support gut health by enhancing antioxidant enzyme activity and alleviating intestinal inflammatory responses, thereby establishing a stable gut microenvironment conducive to nutrient absorption and lipid metabolism regulation.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: Digestive enzyme activity is a critical indicator reflecting intestinal development, digestive capacity, and feed utilization efficiency [ 35 ], and feed additives can influence nutrient absorption efficiency in fish by modulating the structure of digestive organs and digestive enzyme activity.
statement: 消化酶活性是反映肠道发育、消化能力和饲料利用效率的关键指标，饲料添加剂可以通过调节消化器官结构和消化酶活性来影响鱼类的营养吸收效率。
text_zh: 消化酶活性是反映肠道发育、消化能力和饲料利用效率的关键指标，饲料添加剂可以通过调节消化器官结构和消化酶活性来影响鱼类的营养吸收效率。
text_en: Digestive enzyme activity is a key indicator reflecting intestinal development, digestive capacity, and feed utilization efficiency. Feed additives can affect the nutrient absorption efficiency of fish by regulating the structure of digestive organs and digestive enzyme activity.

quote: Previous studies have confirmed that TB can significantly increase the activity of intestinal lipase, amylase, and trypsin in fish, while also increasing villus length and improving the thickness of the muscular layer, thereby expanding the intestinal absorptive surface area [ 36 , 37 ].
statement: 先前的研究证实，TB可以显著增加鱼类肠道脂肪酶、淀粉酶和胰蛋白酶的活性，同时增加绒毛长度并改善肌层厚度，从而扩大肠道吸收表面积。
text_zh: 先前的研究证实，TB可以显著增加鱼类肠道脂肪酶、淀粉酶和胰蛋白酶的活性，同时增加绒毛长度并改善肌层厚度，从而扩大肠道吸收表面积。
text_en: Previous studies have confirmed that TB can significantly increase the activity of intestinal lipase, amylase and trypsin in fish, while increasing villus length and improving muscularis thickness, thereby expanding the intestinal absorption surface area.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: Compared to the base breeding population “Huakang No. 1”, the survival rate of GQ increased by an average of 12.6%, indicating that immune-related genes were also under selection.
statement: 与基础育种群体“华康一号”相比，GQ群体的存活率平均提高了12.6%，表明免疫相关基因也受到了选择。
text_zh: 与基础育种群体“华康一号”相比，GQ群体的存活率平均提高了12.6%，表明免疫相关基因也受到了选择。
text_en: Compared to the base breeding population 'Huakang No. 1', the survival rate of the GQ population increased by an average of 12.6%, indicating that immune-related genes were also under selection.

quote: Additional studies indicate that deficiency of npy2r can increase food intake in fish [ 48 ].
statement: 其他研究表明，npy2r的缺乏可以增加鱼类的食物摄入量。
